from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from a Common Data Set document about a university."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="Name of the university")
    total_undergraduate_population: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate population from Section B1")
    six_year_graduation_rate_2015_cohort: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort from Section B4-B21")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
